verdict.rationale: Content was extracted from several dos.ny.gov guidance pages, including the incorporation, Division of Corporations and forming-a-corporation pages and the homepage. That implies the public reading surface was fetched without a bot wall, JS shell or CAPTCHA. The 404 probe responses also show the server answering the agent rather than blocking it. The transport-level block on filings.dos.ny.gov and the robots 'Disallow: /' on Business Express affect transactional portals, not the guidance pages. missing for 10: an explicit probe recording HTTP 200 with the identified UA on the guidance pages themselves, and confirmation that the content is server-rendered rather than inferred from extracted quotes.
